terms.definition: Hold funds on a customer's payment method without charging. Creates an authorization that can be captured later or voided. See [Authorize API](../../api-reference/services/payment-service/authorize.md).

3D Secure verification process where the customer verifies ownership of their card through their bank (password, SMS, or biometric). See [Authentication Service](../../api-reference/services/payment-method-authentication-service/).
Capture funds immediately upon authorization. Used for digital goods and same-day fulfillment.
Buy Now Pay Later. Payment method type allowing customers to split purchases into installments (Klarna, Afterpay, Affirm).
Complete a payment by transferring funds from the customer's account. Can be full or partial amount. See [Capture API](../../api-reference/services/payment-service/capture.md).
`AUTOMATIC` (immediate) or `MANUAL` (merchant-initiated). Determines when funds transfer.
Payment processor integration (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, etc.). Connector Service supports 50+ connectors.
Rust module that translates unified requests to connector-specific formats. See [Connectors](../../connectors/).
The unified payment abstraction library this documentation describes.
Entity representing a payer. Can have stored payment methods and transaction history.
Rejection of a payment by the issuer or processor. Reasons: insufficient funds, expired card, incorrect CVV, etc.
Chargeback initiated by a customer through their bank. Requires merchant response (accept or defend).
Domain-Specific Language. The Protocol Buffer schema that defines Connector Service's typed API.
Deployment mode: `development` (mock), `sandbox` (test credentials), `production` (live transactions).
Unified error identifier (e.g., `PAYMENT_DECLINED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`). Same code across all connectors.
Handles service specific webhooks (payment/refund/dispute) from payment processors. See [Event Service](../../api-reference/services/event-service/).
Foreign Function Interface. Mechanism allowing SDKs to call Rust core code from Node.js, Python, Java, etc.
Payment operation type (Authorize, Capture, Refund, etc.).
High-performance RPC framework using Protocol Buffers. Used for microservice mode.
Process any incoming webhook from a payment processor. See [handle](../../api-reference/services/event-service/handle.md).
Open-source Composable Payments Platform built by Juspay with 40K+ Github stars and used by global enterprise companies. The Connector Service is a component of Juspay Hyperswitch.
Unique identifier preventing duplicate operations. Retry the same request safely.
Increase authorized amount after initial authorization. Used by hotels and car rentals.
Merchant-initiated capture (two-step payment flow).
Business entity processing payments through Connector Service.
Key-value pairs attached to payments for reconciliation and reporting.
Request-level configuration that supersedes connector defaults.
Capture less than authorized amount. Used for multi-shipment orders.
Stripe's term for a payment authorization. Connector Service unifies this concept across all connectors.
How customer pays: card, wallet, bank transfer, BNPL.
Core service handling authorizations, captures, voids. See [Payment Service](../../api-reference/services/payment-service/).
Lifecycle state: `STARTED`, `AUTHORIZED`, `CAPTURED`, `FAILED`, `VOIDED`.
Binary serialization format. Defines Connector Service's typed schema.
Payment Service Provider. Synonym for payment processor/connector.
Subscription billing using stored payment methods.
Return captured funds to customer. Can be partial or full amount.
Handles refunds and refund status checks. See [Refund Service](../../api-reference/services/refund-service/).
Re-attempt failed requests for retryable errors (network timeouts, rate limits).
Where customer returns after 3D Secure or redirect-based payments.
Refund using connector transaction ID instead of Connector Service payment ID.
Software Development Kit. Language-specific client libraries (Node.js, Python, Java, Rust, Go).
API endpoint grouping (PaymentService, RefundService, EventService).
Current state of a payment, refund, or other entity.
Service that extends another (RefundService is sub-service of PaymentService).
Retrieve latest status from payment processor.
Secure reference to stored payment method (PCI-safe alternative to raw card data).
Function converting unified types to connector-specific formats.
Consistent error format regardless of underlying connector.
Common data structure used across all connectors (Money, PaymentMethod, Address).
Schema-level checks ensuring request correctness before sending to processors.
Cancel an authorization without charging. Releases held funds.
Digital payment method (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal).
HTTP callback from payment processor notifying of events (payment captured, refund completed).
Shared key for verifying webhook authenticity.
